Flu: Rest at home, stay hydrated, take paracetamol for fever. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 3 days.
COVID-19: Isolate, monitor oxygen levels, stay hydrated, take paracetamol for fever. Seek medical attention if breathing difficulty occurs.
Pneumonia: Antibiotics if bacterial, rest, fluids, and fever reducers. Hospitalization may be required for severe cases.
Asthma: Use prescribed inhaler, avoid triggers, seek emergency care if severe shortness of breath.
Diabetes: Monitor blood sugar, take prescribed medication, maintain healthy diet and exercise.
Hypertension: Take antihypertensive medication, reduce salt intake, regular exercise, monitor blood pressure.
Chickenpox: Rest, calamine lotion for itching, keep skin clean, avoid scratching blisters.
Malaria: Take antimalarial drugs as prescribed, rest, stay hydrated, seek medical care for complications.
Typhoid: Antibiotics, rest, drink plenty of fluids, eat soft foods, maintain hygiene.
Tuberculosis: Long-term antibiotics, regular follow-up, good nutrition, avoid spreading infection.
Food Poisoning: Drink fluids, rest, avoid solid foods until vomiting stops, seek medical care if severe.
Allergy: Avoid allergens, take antihistamines, use nasal sprays for congestion, consult doctor for severe reactions.
Migraine: Lie down in a dark room, apply cold compress to forehead, take ibuprofen. Avoid triggers like bright lights.
Sinusitis: Steam inhalation, saline nasal spray, pain relievers, antibiotics if bacterial.
Otitis Media: Pain relievers, warm compress, antibiotics if bacterial, consult doctor for persistent symptoms.
Conjunctivitis: Use lubricating eye drops, avoid touching eyes, antibiotics if bacterial, maintain eye hygiene.
Psoriasis: Moisturize skin, use medicated creams, avoid triggers, consult dermatologist for severe cases.
Guillain-Barre Syndrome: Hospitalization, supportive care, physical therapy, immunotherapy as prescribed.
Jaundice: Treat underlying cause, rest, avoid alcohol, maintain hydration, consult doctor for persistent symptoms.
Fungal Infection: Use antifungal creams or medications, keep affected area dry, maintain hygiene.
Common Cold: Gargle salt water for sore throat, use over-the-counter decongestants, rest and drink fluids.
